notes:
2026-09-12: migrated to the unified v2 Fact model (to/from, no id, required annotations). Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json, collector_number 68): "Create a 3/3 blue Robot Warrior artifact creature token. Then if this spell was cast from a graveyard, put two +1/+1 counters on that token. / Flashback {5}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)", Sorcery, {3}{U}. 6 source facts, sink stays empty (unchanged — no real 'wants' on this card): the same 4-fact Flashback baseline from-father-to-son (fin/20) / dreams-of-laguna (fin/50, both migrated 2026-09-12) established — self-cast (Hand, typeLine-anchored) + self-to-Graveyard (608.2m, typeLine-anchored) + self-cast via Flashback (Graveyard, oracle-anchored to the reminder text) + self-to-Exile (thenExile, oracle-anchored) — mirrored exactly, including which reminder-text substrings get anchored (byte-identical indices to dreams-of-laguna's own: 26/83 for the Flashback cast clause, 85/98 for 'Then exile it'). Plus 2 card-specific facts: token creation ({event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', subject:{token:'u_3_3_robot_warrior'}}, oracle-anchored to 'Create a 3/3 blue Robot Warrior artifact creature token') and the conditional bonus counters ({event:'putCounter', counterType:'+1/+1', controller:'you', target:{name:{eq:'Robot Warrior'}}}, oracle-anchored to 'put two +1/+1 counters on that token').

Tokens: added a new `TOKENS.u_3_3_robot_warrior` entry (tokens.ts) — real printed FIN token (name confirmed in data/fin/fin_tokens_scryfall.json; that registry carries no P/T, so 3/3 comes straight off this card's own oracle text, same limitation the file's own header already documents for its other ad-hoc entries). definition.ts's own `createToken` call was updated to reference `TOKENS.u_3_3_robot_warrior` instead of an inline literal, so the fact's `subject:{token:'u_3_3_robot_warrior'}` corresponds to something real, matching aerith-rescue-mission/battle-menu's own already-migrated token-fact precedent (the only other real precedent of `subject:{token:...}` actually appearing in a v2 synergy.json).

**Conditional 'if cast from a graveyard, put counters' effect — real 'different effect depending on cast origin' case, per task instruction.** Checked Phoenix Down first (its own Choose-one modal is a different shape — player-chosen branching, not cast-origin-conditional — not a real precedent for this). The real, directly-on-point precedent is from-father-to-son's own already-migrated castFrom-conditional branch ('put it into your hand' vs 'put it onto the battlefield instead') — its house style represents each branch as its OWN separate real fact, annotated to that branch's own specific oracle clause, with NO explicit castFrom/mode tag anywhere in the Fact schema (checked: Fact has no `face`/`castFrom`/`mode` field for this). Followed the same approach: the bonus counters got their own separate `putCounter` fact (distinct from the token-creation fact, which fires on BOTH cast modes), annotated ONLY to 'put two +1/+1 counters on that token' (the condition itself, 'Then if this spell was cast from a graveyard,', is NOT part of the highlighted span — same exclusion from-father-to-son's own conditional fact already establishes) — the conditionality is documented here in prose/this note, not encoded as a new schema field, since no real second card yet needs to WANT 'only a cast-from-graveyard-conditional effect' as an actual matchable thing. Also gave this fact a real `target: {name:{eq:'Robot Warrior'}}` (not `target:'self'`, which would incorrectly mean 'this card', and not left unconstrained) — the counters land on the created TOKEN, not the card itself or any type-filtered bucket; NameConstraint is already real, established vocabulary (rufus-shinra's own sink `{name:{eq:'Darkstar'}}` wanting its own real token by name) even though this is the first SOURCE-side (target-filter) use of it rather than a sink-side presence-want use.

Scenarios: converted from the old plain harness.ts Scenario[] pair (hand-cast, standalone graveyard/Flashback-cast) to a single real engine-piloted `runEngineScenarios()` playthrough, per the task's own explicit instruction to mirror fin/20/50's one-scenario-both-modes consolidation — cast from hand, resolve for real (creates the token, no bonus counters), THEN cast the SAME real card instance again from the graveyard via Flashback, resolve again (creates a second token, this time WITH the +1/+1 counters), naturally demonstrating the real conditional difference within one continuous playthrough. Real basic Islands for both combined costs ({3}{U}+{5}{U}={8}{U}{U}, no land reused between the two payments); `libraryCount: 1` (just enough to survive the pilot's own real CR 103.8a first-draw exposure during setup — this card's own effect never draws or searches, so no further library padding is needed, unlike dreams-of-laguna/from-father-to-son which both need extra library cards for their own real draws/searches).

Ran `compute-annotations.mjs retrieve-the-esper` (6/6 facts annotated for real, no manual index placement) and `compute-weights.mjs --slug=retrieve-the-esper` (real per-card trace magnitudes: value 1 on every fact except the putCounter fact, which gets 4 — magnitude 2 bucketed steeply, matching the OLD pre-migration v1 file's own value:4 on that same real effect, a nice independent consistency check). Added 'retrieve-the-esper' to `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs`'s `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`.

Verified: `verify-synergy.mjs` scoped (retrieve-the-esper) -> 0 hard failures (only the same accepted `tapForMana` soft notes every engine-piloted Flashback card gets). Full pool (317 v2 cards checked): 9 hard failures, none on retrieve-the-esper — confirmed via `git status` that all 9 (cargo-ship, cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, dragoon-s-wyvern, ice-flan, il-mheg-pixie, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, the-wind-crystal, white-auracite, zack-fair) are files under active concurrent edit by other live sessions during this task, not touched here. `annotation-coverage.test.ts` also currently fails pool-wide, but isolated the check to just this card's own synergy.json (`findMissingAnnotations` with `slugs:['retrieve-the-esper']`) and confirmed zero violations — the real failures are on 'the-prima-vista'/'the-lunar-whale', two other in-flight concurrent migrations (their own allowlist entries appeared in `annotation-coverage.mjs` during this same task, not added by this task). `vitest run functional-model`: 238/238 unchanged. `find-synergies.mjs` diff (isolated via a temp `git show HEAD:<path>` swap of just this card's own synergy.json, restored immediately after, rather than trusting a pool-wide before/after snapshot given the same concurrent-editing flux documented above): BEFORE 27 lines (12 illegitimate v1 'battlefield presence' + 13 'graveyard presence' + 2 'counters' — the old unconstrained-recipient putCounter fact false-matching Aerith Gainsborough's and Zack Fair's own dies/lifegain-payoff counter sinks) -> AFTER 25 lines (same 12 relabeled 'enters the battlefield' + same 13 relabeled 'moves to graveyard', both expected renames from the source-fact-is-a-movement-not-presence convention every zone-fact migration already goes through; the 2 'counters' matches are correctly LOST, not a regression — the new fact's real `target:{name:{eq:'Robot Warrior'}}` recipient scope means it no longer satisfies a sink wanting counters on ITSELF, `target:'self'`, which is the textually accurate behavior: this card's counters genuinely never land on Aerith or Zack Fair). Net -2, fully accounted for, a correctness fix not a loss.

No Forge verification still needed for this pass — Flashback/token-creation/conditional-counters are all already-real, already-cited engine mechanics (card.ts's `alternateCosts`, `createToken`/`putCounter` actions); this card introduces no new engine machinery, only new Fact-vocabulary usage (the first real SOURCE-side `target:{name:{eq:...}}` use) built on already-existing, already-cited execution.
